title: Jody R NDE 686
content:
The following is a transcription of the experience as it was described to me: I was sitting in my chair at home in Midland when I lost consciousness. I was gone for a whole two days although they told me that I was out for only a short time. To me I know it was two days and it was really, really real. Just as sure as I'm a sitting here talking to you it was really real. I saw angels, I was flying, I saw the most beautiful, beautiful place, and it was really, really real. I can't tell you how real it was. Do you know whom I didn't see? Floyd, my husband, who died in 2001. I don't know why I didn't see him but it was really real. I was gone for two days.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Just Old Life threatening event, but not clinical death Heart attack, stroke.
elements.The experience included: Out of body experience | A landscape or city | Strong emotional tone | Presence of unearthly beings
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: No No, I was there and it was real.
elements.At what time during the experience were: I was clear as a bell and I could see the most beautiful, beautiful place that I had ever seen in my entire life. And it was real really, really real.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning I was gone for two days.
elements.Did your hearing differ in any way from: Just peace, true peace, and I saw angels.
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Yes Angels but I didn't see Floyd (my deceased husband).
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Yes There was light everywhere and I was flying.
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm It was very beautiful more so than anything I have ever seen and it was really, really real.
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will I was there and a flying around and seeing the angels then all of the sudden I was back here.
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes Now I know that you just don't ever really know but except to have faith but now I KNOW I KNOW that it is really, really real and you know that Ma would never lie about that it was really, really real.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: The beauty and the peace was the best part, and flying. I saw so many things and I went all over, but I didn't see Floyd; I wonder why that was, I didn't like that much but it was real and when I go back I'm not coming back here.
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes Oh my, I want to tell the world that it is really there, that I was gone for two days, that I saw and flew with angels, and that it is real - but some people just smile at me like this old woman has lost her mind. But I'm here to tell you I was there and it was real.
elements.Is there anything else that you would li: People believe what they want to and most people are good, even though they don't seem like it sometimes, they really are. There is a place not of this earth, which is as real as this world. It does not have the problems or cares that we have on earth and it is real. It is, and I think I was supposed to see it and come back to tell you that it is real really real, and when I go I won't come back but I'll be there and wait for you because it's really real. It really is.
